newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia court to consider suit against insurer sale.
newsitem.headline: Russia court to consider suit against insurer sale.

text.p: The Moscow Arbitration Court will consider a suit from a union of depositors in Russia's biggest insurer OAO Rosgosstrakh against the State Property Committee, Russia's privatisation ministry, on June 2, Interfax news agency said on Wednesday.

Interfax quoted the head of the union, Vera Balakireva, as saying that the reason for the suit was fears that a privatised Rosgosstrakh would not repay money on policies issued before economic reforms started in 1992.
According to different estimates, Rosgosstrakh owes between 24 and 30 trillion roubles at 1992 prices (up to $300 million at exchange rates early that year).
Under government privatisation plans, Rossgosstrakh employees have already bought 20 percent of shares and its management team has a priority right for 30 percent.
A further 50 percent are to be sold at a cash auction this year.
The Moscow Arbitration Court dropped a suit from the union on the legality of Rosgosstrakh privatisation in March.
Interfax quoted Balakireva as saying the new suit was filed on April 25.
